uci_online_retail_ii.citation: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II. UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI: 10.24432/C5CG6D.
uci_online_retail_ii.usage: Seed real transaction description text and positive amount distributions for a bounded subset of synthetic OTHER-category bank transactions. Source customer IDs are irreversibly hashed and are not used as final customer IDs.

london_smart_meter.usage: Seed the empirical distribution of household monthly electricity consumption. Only hashed household keys and aggregated profiles are retained.

uk_ghg_conversion_factors_2026.publisher: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
uk_ghg_conversion_factors_2026.usage: Populate the versioned emissions-factor reference table with exact activity units and kg CO2e factors.
